{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only the two channels of interest
channel_subset = sales_df[sales_df['channel'].isin(['email', 'paid_search'])]

# Compute conversion rate for each channel
def compute_conversion_rate(df, channel):
    subset = df[df['channel'] == channel]
    return subset['converted'].mean()

email_rate = compute_conversion_rate(channel_subset, 'email')
paid_search_rate = compute_conversion_rate(channel_subset, 'paid_search')

# Compute difference in conversion rates
difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

# Print the raw difference only
email_rate, paid_search_rate, difference"}
